name: MemTrace synthetic demo case
notice: DEMO DATA - NOT REAL FORENSIC EVIDENCE. Synthetic Volatility 3-format JSON for demonstration only.
scenario: A user opens a macro-enabled document; WINWORD spawns encoded PowerShell, which retrieves a second stage, drops a masquerading svchost.exe in C:\Users\Public and launches rundll32 with a DLL from %TEMP%. The fake svchost shows injected executable memory with a PE header, a C2-like connection and a handle to lsass.exe. A child process is unlinked from the active list.
addresses: All external IPs are RFC 5737 documentation addresses; domains use the RFC 2606 .example TLD.
